task.title: Deleting an immutability policy by using the Red Hat Quay API
task.shortdesc: To remove an immutability policy so that tags can be modified or deleted again, you can delete the policy for an organization or a repository in Red Hat Quay by using the API. Send a DELETE request with your bearer token and the policy UUID.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.
You have set FEATURE_IMMUTABLE_TAGS to True in your config.yaml file.
